note: Symbols the nightly EOD zone scan checks. Edit this list and commit to change it. NSE equities use .NS (BSE uses .BO); commodities use the global futures Yahoo carries (GC=F gold, SI=F silver, CL=F WTI crude, NG=F natural gas, HG=F copper) — the contracts MCX prices track. Every symbol must exist on Yahoo: renamed or delisted tickers are reported as unavailable instead of failing silently. TATAMOTORS.NS was replaced by its two demerger successors TMCV.NS (commercial vehicles) and TMPV.NS (passenger vehicles); LTIM.NS was dropped after Yahoo stopped carrying it.
